decisions.reason: Configuring the contract-event webhook does not change the required FAQ content.
The webhook configuration may support backend processing, but it does not change which NFT metadata attributes must be visible or accurate.
The webhook configuration does not alter the mint-number referral-code basis, persistence, or display locations.
Capturing contract logs does not change winner eligibility, ticket weighting, Chainlink VRF selection, or the draw rules.
The webhook configuration is unrelated to landing-page hero copy and selling-point emphasis.
The webhook configuration does not change the hero section's layout, sizing, or image placement.
Capturing contract events does not resolve or change whether prizes are transferred automatically or exposed through a conditional claim interaction.
The webhook setup does not change the rule that the dashboard shows only NFTs actually owned under the active contract.

Although the webhook captures referral and ticket events, its configuration does not change the required accounting totals, surfaces, pairing, or first-mint exception; implementation status must not be propagated.
The contract-event webhook is unrelated to remediation of Blockaid's wallet-security warning.
Capturing ReferralUsed and TicketsAwarded logs does not change the no-code trigger, random recipient, reward package, or first-mint exception.
The webhook configuration does not change the required flat royalty, ERC-721C standard, or marketplace controls.
